topic: What if you had an iPhone 100 years ago?

script.text: You walk downstairs. You put the phone on the table. The man reaches for it.
And it buzzes. One bar of signal. In 1926. Which is impossible. Unless someone else is here too.
A message appears. 'Don't give it to him.' One percent. And the screen goes black.
In the dark, you hear the man in the grey suit laugh, very softly. 'Well,' he says. 'That changes things.'
Mo grabs your sleeve. Upstairs, Ellie coughs in her sleep. And on the table, the dead phone is warm, as if something inside it is still awake.
So what would you do? Save Ellie, or save the future? Tell me in the comments.

And is any of this real? The rules are. No cell network until 1979. No GPS until 1978. No penicillin until 1928. A hundred years ago, a computer was a person with a pencil. And whoever sent that message? You'll find out in part two.
